about: Discovery pixel issue keys (the status_key in get_pixel_health_status top_issues) seen in testing, with their likely meaning and the usual fix, written for a merchandiser to pass on. Apps read this file too, so change a fix here and nowhere else. Confirm the cause with get_pixel_event_details on one sample event before reporting it.

catalogs_required.meaning: The pixel doesn't send the catalogs parameter that this account or page type requires.
catalogs_required.fix: The pixel on these pages doesn't send the catalogs parameter. Ask your site developers to add it.

cat_id_required.meaning: A category page view without a category ID.
cat_id_required.fix: Category page views arrive without a category ID. Ask your site developers to send cat_id and cat on every category page.

cat_required.meaning: A category page view without a category name.
cat_required.fix: Category page views arrive without a category name. Ask your site developers to send cat_id and cat on every category page.

url_invalid.meaning: The page URL is malformed or missing.
url_invalid.fix: The page address sent is missing or malformed. Ask your site developers to send the full, encoded page URL.

ref_invalid.meaning: The referrer is malformed or missing.
ref_invalid.fix: The referrer sent is missing or malformed. Ask your site developers to send the full, encoded referrer.

missing_uid.meaning: No _br_uid_2 cookie value, so the visit can't be tied to a visitor.
missing_uid.fix: Visits arrive without the tracking cookie, so they can't be tied to a visitor. Check the cookie is set before the pixel fires, including after consent.

cdp_segments_invalid.meaning: The segment value in the cookie couldn't be parsed.
cdp_segments_invalid.fix: The segment value in the tracking cookie couldn't be read. This is usually low volume; ask your site developers to look only if it grows.

cookie2_cdp_segments_invalid.meaning: The segment value in the cookie couldn't be parsed.
cookie2_cdp_segments_invalid.fix: The segment value in the tracking cookie couldn't be read. This is usually low volume; ask your site developers to look only if it grows.

fallback_fix: Ask your site developers to fix the pixel on these pages; until then, reports that rely on it undercount.
